svg.title: IconGrip
svg.desc: The layer-reorder grip: six dots in two columns, from variant B of docs/design/mockups/explorations/reorder-control-variants.html. The ONE glyph on this feature that is not traced from a locked mockup - the locked set has no reorder affordance at all - so it is authored in the same 24-unit box as every other icon here and drawn at the exploration's own centers (x 9.5/14.5, y 6/12/18). The mockup's circles are r=1.45 and `fill: currentColor`. A Path.ico is a single STROKED path (Fill=Transparent, StrokeThickness=2 in these 24 units), so a filled dot is expressed as a circle small enough for its own stroke to close the middle: r=0.45 plus the 1-unit stroke half-width on each side paints a solid disc of radius 1.45 - the mockup's dot exactly, arrived at by the same trick IconDiceFace uses for its pips.
